title: Questions 164-167 refer to the following notice.
passage_1:
NOTICE: RESEARCH LABORATORY – ACCESS RESTRICTED

Authorised Personnel Only

Please be advised that entry to the Cell Culture Laboratory is strictly forbidden to all unauthorised staff with immediate effect. Because of the sensitive nature of the experiments now in progress, only senior researchers holding a Grade 3 biosafety clearance or above may enter this area.

Access Protocol: Eligible staff must scan their pass at the outer door and then key in their personal code. All entries and exits are electronically documented by the control room 24 hours a day.

Exception for Cleaning: Cleaning staff may enter only during the scheduled sterilization period, which takes place every Tuesday morning from 7:00 A.M. to 9:00 A.M. Throughout that time, every cleaner must be accompanied by a security officer and is required to wear a full protective suit.

Penalties: Strict observance of this protocol is compulsory. Failure to follow these rules will result in immediate disciplinary action, ranging from a written caution to suspension without pay.

Management
